get.description: Public: whether the sign-in screen must show first-run setup instead of the login form.

post.description: Create the first administrator. Needs the one-time code from the server's console.
Second step of a sign-in with 2FA: a 6-digit authenticator code or one single-use recovery code.
Ends every session except the one making the request.
Confirm the password (or a 2FA code) again; the token unlocks destructive actions for 5 minutes.

Restart (or start) the VM and press Enter every 0.5 s for 12 s: Windows installers boot from the ISO only
when a key is pressed within ~5 s, which a console that reconnects after the reset almost always misses.
Bind another host folder at Ollama's models folder, optionally moving the downloaded models along.

get.description: The deployment as a unified stage-progress view (same shape as /api/tasks/{job_id}).

post.description: Install an app (same body as the driver's POST /api/apps/deploy; the path's app_id wins).
Create or update a share; the directory (or a dedicated ZFS dataset) is created if missing.
Create the Samba user (and a login-less Unix account behind it) or change its password.

put.description: Replace the stored preferences. The frontend owns the schema (layout, dock, wizard, theme); placement and theme are validated.

post.description: Bind-mount an existing dataset into the SolarDeck container under /mnt/storage/<dataset>.

delete.description: Clear every counter. SolarDeck has a single (admin) login, which require_user already enforces.

get.description: Key + connectivity status of the root SSH bridge (shown in Control Panel).
Light poll for live GPU numbers (nvidia-smi / amdgpu sysfs) while the panel is open.
Board/BIOS facts: dmidecode, then /sys/devices/virtual/dmi/id, then the provider's host status. Never a 500.
Stage progress of a GPU job (null if it never ran on this host).
BIOS/UEFI guides for this board (or `vendor` override), marking the ones this host needs, with text QR codes.

post.description: Apply a fix. Returns {message, job?}; a job streams its log at /api/host/jobs/{job}.
Clear a finished or failed update, so the page shows the idle state again (the log stays on disk).

get.description: Conversation summaries, newest first; `q` searches titles and message text (case-insensitive).

patch.description: Rename without touching `updated`, so the conversation keeps its place in the list.

delete.description: Stop renewing the Let's Encrypt certificate and go back to SolarDeck's self-signed one.

post.description: Apply the selected host hardening parts as a detached host job; follow it with GET /api/host/jobs/hardening.

get.description: kvm module `nested` parameter: Y/1 on, N/0 off, None when no kvm module is loaded.

post.description: Undo an unconfirmed apply now (the same restore the timer would run).
Drop the staged (not yet applied) changes.

put.description:
Edit a device's hardware metadata. Virtual devices: options (the feed of a camera, a modem's dial target, an
HBA model …) and identity overrides; `guest_visible` in the detailed view says which identity fields the guest
itself shows. NICs (net0 … net7): name, MAC, model, switch, VLAN tag, trunks, link and rate, applied at once.

get.description:
Everything the Wireframe Node Architect draws: specs, virtual devices with identity, NICs with their endpoint,
passthrough devices, disks and host / cluster placement.

post.description:
Move one guest NIC to another virtual switch / physical bridge / router bridge, VLAN or isolated lab in one
call. The NIC keeps its MAC, model, rate and link state; trunks are dropped (the port becomes an access port).
Joining a lab records the NIC's previous endpoint, so deleting the lab puts it back.
Give each seat an equal, non-overlapping share of whole physical cores (with their SMT siblings).
Start every enabled seat one after the other, 3 seconds apart (vfio-pci binding first).
Authorize a newly connected Thunderbolt / USB4 enclosure (boltctl enrolls it for good) and rescan PCI.
After a worker container finished deploying: put it on its network, then re-apply rules and the module.

get.description: Quick-pick targets: App Center instances (with their address) plus every VM and container.

post.description: One-click leaf / wildcard certificate signed by the private root CA (created first when there is none).
Put the archived configuration back. The backend restarts afterwards so every module reloads it.

get.description: 3-2-1 overview: copies on this host, offsite targets and their last run, last sandbox checks.

post.description: Turn a configured, shut-down VM into a golden template (on some hypervisors a one-way step).

delete.description: Remove the template from the hub list (the template VM itself stays; delete it in Compute).

get.description: USB devices that look like a UPS (`nut-scanner -U`), for the setup form.

post.description: Give a VM a serial port where the hypervisor needs one for its serial console.

put.description: The whole ordered rule list (first match wins); the UI reorders by sending it again.

post.description: Give a VM the whole USB drive as a disk (unmount it on the host first).
This host as a lightweight quorum witness: grants its vote to one host of a cluster at a time (lease).

get.description: auth_request target: 200 when the gate cookie belongs to a live SolarDeck session for this host, else 401.
Visitor without a gate cookie: needs a SolarDeck session, then gets a one-time ticket for the proxied host.
Reached through the proxied host: trades the ticket for an HttpOnly cookie on that host.

DeviceUpdate.title: DeviceUpdate
DeviceUpdate.description:
PUT body: `options` / `identity` for a virtual device; the NIC fields for net0 … net7. Omitted fields keep
their value; a NIC's `vlan_tag: null` removes the tag.

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: A theme file; unknown keys (an export's "format" marker) are dropped.

address.title: Address
address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address in CIDR notation
